write.text: It was late in the harbor when the last boat came in, and it was the last man on the ship. He was a big, strong man, and he was a good swimmer. He was the only one who could swim. The sun was setting in the west, and the sky was changing colors. This man, now a man of about forty, was beginning to feel the signs of the approaching old age. He had a lot of trouble in his back, and his hands were beginning to shake. He looked like a man who was going to be very sick. He had been on the ship all his life, and had seen many changes in the world. He had seen a war, and many people were killed or hurt. He had seen the rise and fall of many nations and the changing of many rulers. He had seen a great war in the sea, in which the whole country was in danger. He had seen the destruction of the great cities, the loss of the population, and the death of many children. He had seen the end of the world in a fire. He had seen the coming of the age of science.
